done_when: When the tests close would pick cover more than a third of the suite, close skips the local run, says so in one line, and relies on the pull request's required checks

findings.body: The new threshold applies only to pytest. In a Node client where a shared module change makes Vitest or Jest select most test files, `close_tests` still runs the local selection through `--changed` or `--changedSince` (src/forge/fasttest.py:231-244). That leaves the same long local run for those clients. The Done-when line does not name another language, so this is a non-blocking follow-up.
findings.title: Follow-up: large Vitest and Jest selections

why: When a change touches many files, close's local tests turn into the full suite, which takes about an hour on a laptop while GitHub runs it anyway
